results.title: SceneNote: Free video feedback tool for editors & clients | Product Hunt
results.content:
So my take would be that Vimeo makes sense if you want everything under one roof. It's a hosting platform first, so your videos live there, you can embed them, manage team access, and review is built on top of that. If you're already paying for the hosting, review comes along with it.

SceneNote is just the feedback layer, on purpose. No account for you or your reviewers, annotations drawn straight on the frame, voice notes that transcribe themselves, and notes you can export as CSV or EDL and drop into Premiere pro, DaVinci resolve or Final cut pro as timeline markers. It works off links rather than uploads, so there's no storage cap. [...] Share
